purpose: counter verification against brute force, conservation and closed-form controls, auxiliary-machinery controls, and H016/H017 port fidelity

A_counter_verification.note: agreement is on the FULL per-target count vector over all N targets, not only on the total

greedy.leakage_structural_guard: greedy_select() has no access to the held-out mask; only train_bits is passed

height_equivalence.note: the enumerated minimum over all coprime (u,v) with max(|u|,|v|) <= h_max agrees with the continued-fraction convergent minimum for every x in [0,p) on this curve

small_multiples_log_space.note: dedup-by-x of x(jG), j=1..2B is a no-op in log space for 2B < N/2, so the H017 base is {1,...,B}: this makes the H017 geometry exactly reproducible from the recorded convention without knowing G

recorded_conventions.decomposition: triples i<=j<=k, P1+P2+P3=R; logs known by construction; membership via log->index map
recorded_conventions.qr_base: first B distinct points of a deterministic r-adding walk (r=20, c_j in [1,2^10)) off G with x a QR mod p
recorded_conventions.small_mult_base: x(jG), j=1..2B deduplicated by x, truncated to B
recorded_conventions.targets: 800 uniform targets per curve, same set for all bases

sampling_reconstruction.protocol: 800 uniform targets per curve, same set for all bases (recorded convention)
sampling_reconstruction.replacement_assumption: with replacement; the record does not state which, and the finite-population correction for 800 of >= 8329 targets is under 5% of the band width

qr_walk_reconstruction.why: the recorded conventions do not pin the walk's RNG stream, index function, or start point, so only a same-family distributional comparison is possible

prior_cell_pvalues_derived_from_record.derivation: derived from the recorded perm_null.null_means and the recorded base means; the record itself stores an explicit p-value only for the QR cell, under the identified 2*min(tail)/n convention
